system.longDesc: Your words and presence motivate others into action.

degree0.desc: You inspire calm and courage in your friends and allies. If you are conscious and they are within sight of you, any allies gain a +1 bonus to all Willpower-related tests.

degree1.desc: With you around, things don’t seem as bad. Once per encounter, you can spend 2 minor actions to offer words of inspiration to your allies. All who hear these words are healed for 1d6 + your Communication, and gain a +2 bonus on their next test. The Health your allies recover in Gritty games is only equal to your Communication.

degree2.desc: You can inspire greatness in others. If you are conscious and they are within sight of you, any ally generating stunt points generates +1 SP.
